**Summarizing physics fix and validation**
**Clarifying constraint break conditions**

Fixed [index.html](/private/var/folders/7z/5mtgxwxx4zs9ppgzm942gbmh0000gn/T/workspace.pi18VI/app/index.html). The car was breaking early because the code checked constraint solver force on every step, including settling, wheel contact, and acceleration. Bonds now break only when a car–brick contact produces wall-derived force or impulse above their thresholds. I also adjusted the front-door threshold to retain visible breakup at impact.

JavaScript syntax and the wall-contact break gate passed static checks. I did not run the simulation or open a browser, as requested.
